units: ms unless suffixed _ns; each host uses its own monotonic clock
endpoint: Mac SurfaceView input function to AVFoundation renderer displayed-buffer identity match; excludes hardware, scanout and panel response

conditions.source: owned GTK X11 counter fixture with 33 ms animation

input_query_formal.notes: 240 per version; no median improvement; reverted

capture_handoff_formal.notes: 240 per version; same GNOME bridge 4; modest median improvement

capture_handoff_diagnostic.notes: 40 per version; separate from formal; median does not improve

capture_owner_before.notes: 40 baseline responses with owner/rearm scheduler spans

notes: Each formal comparison has its own baseline and time window. Do not compare the two trials to each other or subtract the historical 111.42 ms.
Per-stage quantiles cannot be added. Diagnostic runs are separate from uninstrumented formal measurements and do not independently show a median benefit for the retained change.
Formal binaries have no Linux probes. Unknown first readback/I420 IDs remain null; final feedback frame IDs and source counter timestamps are retained.

The mixed residual uses (Mac receive - Mac write end) - (Linux frame write end - Linux input received), covering the entire Agent interval through the final frame. It does not omit first-to-final readback waiting and is not pure network latency.
Scheduler spans include all captured frames, not just matched input frames. Admission/rearm waits may shift between adjacent server requests; individual reductions are not additive savings.

The retained path keeps worker XRES validation before and after readback, trusted process incarnation, scope membership, epoch, resize and controller-refresh checks; no unvalidated cached identity authorizes pixel reads.
The source-GNOME ready-call optimization is installed on disk but was not active in these trials. No bridge-5 latency improvement has been measured yet.
The current AVFoundation renderer endpoint is buffer availability, with query timing included; no Metal presentation feedback or input-to-photon claim.
No compilation, profiling or test gates ran concurrently with formal sampling. User source workload was left intact; each round retains load observations.

The first broad ignored-test run had six failures: three Xvfb reset/connection failures and three mismatched display prerequisites. Rechecks with -noreset passed 14 tests; DAMAGE/RENDER-disabled fallback tests each passed on a matching server. The unchanged DRI3-only pixel test was not rerun on Xvfb.
WebRTC remains reverted and is not present in either tested product path.

raw_archive.redaction: No video pixels, user application content, clipboard, authorization or pairing secrets; session IDs aliased and memory pointers removed after frame correlation.
